> Dashandots Technology is a custom software development company based in Gurugram, India.
> We build enterprise-grade ERP, CRM, TMS, HMS, and custom web/mobile applications for SMEs and growing businesses.

## Company

Dashandots Technology is a software development agency founded to make enterprise technology accessible to small and mid-sized businesses across India and internationally. We deliver end-to-end software — from requirements to deployment and post-launch support.

- **Location:** Gurugram, Haryana, India
- **Website:** https://dashandots.com/
- **Contact:** https://dashandots.com/#contact
- **Email:** Configure a domain email such as hello@dashandots.com in production

## Services

### Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)
Full-cycle ERP development with modules for inventory management, procurement, production planning, finance & accounting, HR & payroll, and reporting dashboards. Designed for Indian SMEs with GST compliance built in.

### Transport Management System (TMS)
Fleet tracking, route optimisation, driver management, freight billing, trip sheets, and logistics automation. Used by transport operators and logistics companies across India.
- Live Demo: https://tms.dashandots.com/login

### Hospital Management System (HMS)
Comprehensive clinic and hospital software covering patient registration, appointment scheduling, EMR/EHR, billing, pharmacy, laboratory, and inventory.
- Live Demo: https://hms.dashandots.com/login

### Customer Relationship Management (CRM)
Sales pipeline, lead tracking, customer lifecycle management, follow-up automation, and reporting for sales teams.

### Custom Web & Mobile Applications
Full-stack web apps (React, Node.js, PHP, Laravel) and mobile apps (Flutter for iOS and Android). Includes portals, dashboards, and SaaS platforms.

### E-commerce & Portals
B2B/B2C online stores, dealer portals, multi-vendor marketplaces. Built with GST invoicing, ERP sync, and payment gateway integration for the Indian market.

### Data Analytics & AI
Business intelligence dashboards, ETL pipelines, ML forecasting, and LLM workflow integrations for data-driven SMEs.

### IoT & Embedded Software
Firmware development (ESP32, STM32), device-cloud pipelines (MQTT, LoRaWAN), OTA updates, and FreeRTOS-based systems.

## Target Clients

Small and medium enterprises (SMEs), logistics companies, healthcare providers, retail chains, and manufacturing firms in India seeking affordable, robust custom software alternatives to expensive off-the-shelf products.
